title: CPH2749_17.0.0.102(EX01) is available
description:
New version: CPH2749_17.0.0.102(EX01)ColorOS 17. Silky Smooth. Flow with AI.

ColorOS 17, a fresh new look.

Smooth from the start, fluid over time. All-new fluid aesthetics. Smooth in motion, vivid by nature.

Laminar Flow Engine now features smarter memory scheduling to deliver sustained stability and smooth performance in both the foreground and background.

OnePlus AI is now more personalized and proactive, deeply attuned to your needs and thoughts. It not only helps you stay one step ahead, but also gets things done for you with its system-level agent capabilities.

Explore and discover more details and delightful experiences along the way.

Smooth from the start, fluid over timeFluid design. Smooth in motion, vivid by nature.

• Introduces an all-new fluid design, crafted for seamless interactions. Smooth in motion, vivid by nature. With seamlessly integrated state transitions, gentle motion rhythms, and lively feedback, the fluid design makes every interaction feel natural.

• Adds responsive light effects that balance readability, transparency, and visual aesthetics in a lightweight, friendly, rounded design.

• Adds fluid animations. Screen and element transitions now feature fluid merging effects, creating seamless connections between elements and more natural transitions between states.

• Adds a flexible feedback system that enables interface elements to naturally stretch, compress under pressure, and rebound dynamically in response to user interactions, while light effects actively respond to user intent and interface changes to convey status, feedback, and guidance through light, making every interaction feel more responsive and creating a more natural, vivid experience.

• Introduces the next-generation Luminous Rendering Engine with a new fused rendering architecture that renders light effects and the user interface together, delivering greater rendering efficiency and more refined, seamless fluid animations and visuals.

• Adds a fluid clock effect that seamlessly carries the clock across the Always-On Display, Lock screen, and Home screen, creating a natural, cohesive unlocking experience.

• Improves the Lock screen swipe-up unlock animation. App icons now animate into view with the fluid clock as a visual anchor, creating a seamless transition from the Lock screen to the Home screen.

• Adds a downward collapse effect for Lock screen notifications, allowing notification cards to stack naturally, and improves the progressive transitions and swipe-rebound animations for notification display changes.

• Adds responsive behavior to the Lock screen clock font, dynamically adjusting its size based on notification content while ensuring readability at the minimum size.

• Improves the visuals and animations of Lock screen widgets, bottom shortcuts, and Live Space capsules, with a new flexible feedback system applied to these elements.

• Improves the Lock screen password keypad visuals by optimizing the progressive entry animation and introducing a flexible feedback system for more responsive interactions.

• Introduces a new Quick Settings design with responsive light effects for tap interactions, providing more vivid feedback, and improves the visuals and animations on certain secondary pages.

• Redesigns the notification drawer with a lighter, more translucent card design, enhancing information contrast and readability. Adds responsive light effects for tap interactions, making the feedback more vivid.

• Improves the transition animation between the notification drawer and Quick Settings by introducing a sequential motion effect and dynamically adjusting element movement based on gesture focus and swipe speed, making transitions more responsive, natural, and fluid.

• The Sublime Grandeur theme wallpapers now display real-time local weather, so you can check the latest weather information directly from
